notes: Extremely versatile: conjunction (that/which/who), relative pronoun, or used in comparisons (mais...do que = more...than). Also in exclamations: Que lindo! = How beautiful!
Core preposition 'to/at'. Also the feminine singular definite article 'the'. Contracts with 'a' (prep) to form 'à' (to the, f.). Pl: as.
Masculine singular definite article. Also direct object pronoun 'him/it'. Contracts: do (de+o), no (em+o), ao (a+o). Pl: os.
Primary negation word. Placed before the verb: Não sei = I don't know. Standalone 'no'. Differs from Spanish: no double negation required.
Core preposition: of/from/about/by. Contracts with articles: do (de+o), da (de+a), dos (de+os), das (de+as).
Conjunction 'and'. Before words starting with e- it can sound like 'i'. Note: é (with accent) = 'is' (verb ser).
Masculine indefinite article 'a/an', also the number 'one'. Feminine: uma. Note: unlike Spanish, Portuguese does NOT drop the article before professions in all contexts.
Preposition with many uses: destination (para Lisboa), purpose (para aprender), recipient (para mim = for me), contrast with 'por' (reason/exchange).
First person singular pronoun. Subject pronouns are often omitted in Portuguese since verb endings convey person, but 'eu' adds emphasis.
Preposition 'with'. Combines with pronouns: comigo (with me), contigo (with you), consigo (with him/her/oneself), connosco (with us).
Multiple roles: reflexive pronoun (ele se levantou = he got up), conjunction 'if/whether' (se vieres = if you come), passive marker.

examples.en: Tell me if you can come.

notes: Preposition: reason/cause (por quê = why/because), exchange (pagar por = pay for), duration (por horas), agent in passive. Contrasts with para (purpose/destination).
Third person masculine singular pronoun. Also used for objects: ele (m.) / ela (f.). Plural: eles/elas.
Coordinating conjunction 'but/however'. Contrasts with 'porém' (more formal) and 'todavia' (literary).

examples.en: I want to go, but I'm tired.

notes: Preposition 'in/at/on'. Contracts with articles: no (em+o), na (em+a), nos (em+os), nas (em+as). Also contracts with este/esse: neste, nesse, etc.
Adverb 'well/fine/very'. Also used as an intensifier (bem cansado = really tired) and in filler expressions (bem... = well...). Antonym: mal.
Demonstrative pronoun 'that/this' (near the listener). Part of the three-way system: isto (near me) / isso (near you) / aquilo (far from both).
Adverb 'how', conjunction 'as/like', verb form (como = I eat). As a question: Como te chamas? = What's your name? As conjunction: faz como eu = do as I do.
The standard word for 'yes'. More emphatic than context-based agreement. Sim, claro! = Yes, of course! Antonym: não.
Adverb/adjective 'more/most/plus'. Comparatives: mais alto = taller. Superlative: o mais alto = the tallest. Also 'anymore': não quero mais = I don't want any more.
Adverb 'here' (near the speaker). Three-way system: aqui (near me) / aí (near you) / ali/lá (far from both).
First person object pronoun: direct (he sees me) and indirect (he gives me). Also reflexive: eu me visto = I get dressed. Attaches to verbs: diz-me = tell me.
Adverb 'very/much' (invariable) or adjective 'many/much' (muita/muitos/muitas). Muito obrigado = Thank you very much. Muito cansado = very tired.
Third person feminine singular pronoun. Also used for feminine objects. Plural: elas.
Core irregular verb: to do/make. Muito versátil. Fazer anos = to have a birthday. O que fazes? = What do you do? Faz favor = please/excuse me.

examples.pt: O que fazes no fim de semana?
examples.en: What do you do on the weekend?

notes: Adverb with several meanings: 'already' (já fiz = I already did), 'now/right away' (já vou = I'm coming), 'anymore' (já não = no longer). Very common filler.

examples.pt: Já fiz os trabalhos de casa.

notes: Permanent/essential 'to be'. Used for identity, origin, profession, material, time, descriptions. Contrast with estar (temporary state/location). Highly irregular.

examples.en: I am Portuguese and I am a teacher.

notes: Adverb 'only/just/alone'. Also adjective: estou só = I'm alone. Note accent (só) vs 'so' (conjunction, meaning 'so that'). Não só... mas também = not only... but also.
Pronoun 'everything/all'. Invariable. Tudo bem? = Is everything alright? Tudo bem! = All good! Contrast with todo/toda/todos/todas (adjective).
Second person singular object pronoun (familiar 'tu' form). Direct and indirect object, also reflexive. Attaches to verb: vejo-te = I see you. More common in European PT.
Conjunction 'because'. Written as one word (conjunction) vs 'por que' (why, in questions) or 'porquê' (noun: the reason why). Very common filler in speech.

examples.pt: Fiquei em casa porque estava doente.
examples.en: I stayed home because I was sick.

notes: Conjunction/adverb 'when'. In questions: Quando chegas? = When are you arriving? In clauses: quando vier = when he comes (takes subjunctive for future).
Adverb 'now/right now'. Agora mesmo = right now. Agora não = not now. Contrast with já (more immediate urgency) and hoje (today, broader).
Second person singular pronoun. More common in Brazilian Portuguese. In European PT, 'tu' is informal and 'você/o senhor/a senhora' is formal. Takes 3rd person singular verb.
Adverb 'there/over there' (far from speaker). Three-way system: aqui (here) / aí (there near you) / lá/ali (over there). Lá fora = outside.
Adverb/conjunction: 'then/so/therefore'. Então, o que fizeste? = So, what did you do? Also used as a conversational filler. E então? = And then? / So what?

examples.en: So, what are we going to do?

notes: Core irregular verb 'to have'. Used for possession (tenho um carro), obligation (tenho de ir = I have to go), and as auxiliary in compound tenses. Ter + de + inf = must/have to.
Adverb/conjunction 'where'. In questions: Onde estás? = Where are you? Relative: a cidade onde vivo = the city where I live. Donde = de onde (from where).
Pronoun/adverb 'nothing/not at all'. De nada = you're welcome. Nada mais = nothing else. When after verb, needs 'não': não faço nada = I don't do anything.
Very common noun for 'thing/something'. Often used as a vague placeholder. Que coisa! = What a thing! / How strange! Alguma coisa = something.
Highly irregular verb 'to say/tell'. Note irregular future/conditional (direi, diria). Dizer que = to say that. Quer dizer = it means / that is.

examples.pt: O que queres dizer com isso?
examples.en: What do you mean by that?

notes: Adjective 'same' or adverb 'really/even'. O mesmo = the same. Mesmo assim = even so. Eu mesmo = myself/I myself. Agora mesmo = right now.
First person plural pronoun 'we/us'. Also used reflexively: nós mesmos = ourselves. In colloquial PT, 'a gente' (literally 'the people') is often used instead.
First person plural object pronoun 'us/ourselves'. Also contraction em+os (nos livros = in the books). Context determines meaning.
Adjective 'good'. Feminine: boa. Plural: bons/boas. Bom dia! = Good morning! Bom, então = Well, then... Irregular comparative: melhor (better), ótimo (best/great).

examples.en: I had a very good day.

notes: Irregular verb 'to see'. Also 'to watch' (ver televisão). Irregular present: vejo. Note: vós form 'vedes' archaic. Já vejo = I see / I understand.
Demonstrative adjective/pronoun 'this' (near speaker). Fem: esta. Pl: estes/estas. Three-way system: este (near me) / esse (near you) / aquele (far). Contracts with em: neste.
Fundamental noun for 'house/home'. Em casa = at home. Ir para casa = to go home. Casa de banho = bathroom (PT-EU); banheiro (PT-BR). Casa de campo = country house.

examples.pt: Estou em casa o dia todo.

notes: Adverb 'never'. When after verb requires 'não': não faço nunca / nunca faço (both correct, second more literary). Nunca mais = never again.
Regular -ar verb 'to speak/talk'. Falar com = to talk to. Falar de = to talk about. Falar mal de = to speak badly of. Sem falar = not to mention.
Adverb 'still/yet/even'. Ainda não = not yet. Ainda bem = good thing / fortunately. Ainda assim = even so. Ainda mais = even more.
Masculine noun with two main meanings: 'time' (Não tenho tempo = I don't have time) and 'weather' (Como está o tempo? = What's the weather like?). Pl: tempos.
Adverb 'also/too/as well'. Placed after the verb or at end. Eu também = me too. Não só... mas também = not only... but also.
Highly irregular verb 'to go'. Present tense built on vad-/va-. Ir + infinitive = going to (future): vou fazer = I'm going to do. Ir embora = to leave/go away.

examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket tomorrow.

notes: Masculine noun 'father/dad'. Plural 'pais' means 'parents' (both father and mother). Pai natal = Father Christmas. Dia do Pai = Father's Day.
Feminine noun for 'time/instance/turn'. Às vezes = sometimes. De vez em quando = from time to time. Uma vez = once. Cada vez mais = more and more. Outra vez = again.

examples.en: Sometimes I go to the cinema.

notes: Adverb/preposition 'after/later/afterwards'. Depois de = after (followed by noun/infinitive). Depois de comer = after eating. Logo depois = shortly after.
Feminine noun 'mother/mom'. Note the nasal diphthong ãe. Mãe de família = mother of a family. Dia da Mãe = Mother's Day. Plural: mães.

examples.pt: A minha mãe faz anos hoje.

notes: Feminine noun 'night/evening'. Boa noite = good evening/good night. À noite = at night. Esta noite = tonight. Noite dentro = late into the night.
Adverb 'always/ever'. Sempre que = whenever. Nem sempre = not always. Para sempre = forever. Sempre a mesma coisa = always the same thing.
Indefinite pronoun 'someone/somebody/anyone'. Há alguém? = Is there anyone? Alguém sabe? = Does anyone know? Antonym: ninguém.
Masculine noun 'day'. Bom dia = good morning. Todos os dias = every day. Um dia = one day (someday). Dia a dia = day by day. Note: masculine despite ending in -a.
Adjective 'right/correct/certain'. Certo? = Right? / Agreed? Estar certo = to be right. Com certeza = certainly/of course. Feminine: certa.
Feminine noun 'life'. Que vida! = What a life! Modo de vida = way of life. Toda a vida = all one's life / always. Ganhar a vida = to earn a living.

examples.pt: A vida é cheia de surpresas.

notes: Temporary/state 'to be'. Used for location, temporary conditions, emotions, progressive. Contrast with ser (permanent). Estar bem = to be well. Como estás? = How are you?
Masculine noun 'man'. Plural: homens. Homem de negócios = businessman. Homem-aranha = Spider-Man. Ser um homem = to be a man (fig.).
Very versatile verb: 'to stay/remain/become/get/be located'. Ficar bem = to look good / to suit. Ficar zangado = to get angry. Onde fica? = Where is it located? Semi-irregular (c→qu).
Adverb/adjective 'of course/clear/light'. Claro que sim! = Of course! Falar claro = to speak clearly. Azul claro = light blue. Está claro? = Is that clear?
Feminine noun 'truth'. A verdade é que... = The truth is that... É verdade = It's true. Dizer a verdade = to tell the truth. De verdade = really/truly. Verdadeiro = true (adj).
Adverb/preposition 'before/beforehand/first'. Antes de = before (followed by noun/inf). Antes de ontem = the day before yesterday. Antes tarde do que nunca = better late than never.

examples.pt: Lava as mãos antes de comer.

notes: Third person singular indirect object pronoun 'to him/her/you (formal)'. Plural: lhes. Dou-lhe o livro = I give him/her the book. In colloquial speech, often replaced by 'a ele/ela'.
Indefinite pronoun 'nobody/no one/anyone (in neg.)'. When after verb, needs 'não': não vi ninguém = I didn't see anyone. Ninguém sabe = Nobody knows.
Masculine noun 'work/job/assignment'. Ir para o trabalho = to go to work. Trabalho de casa = homework. Estar sem trabalho = to be unemployed. Trabalhos = works/assignments.

examples.en: I have a lot of work this week.

notes: Irregular verb 'to know (facts/how to)'. Sei = I know. Não sei = I don't know. Saber + inf = to know how to. Contrast with conhecer (to know a person/place).

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?

notes: Masculine noun 'money'. Ganhar dinheiro = to earn money. Poupar dinheiro = to save money. Gastar dinheiro = to spend money. Sem dinheiro = broke. Not countable in PT.
Adjective/adverb 'little/few/not much'. As adjective it agrees: pouco/pouca/poucos/poucas. As adverb it's invariable: falo pouco = I speak little. Um pouco = a little.
Adjective 'big/great/large'. Invariable for gender (grande homem / grande mulher). Before noun: great (um grande homem = a great man). After noun: big (um homem grande = a big man).

examples.en: I have a very big family.

notes: Feminine noun 'woman/wife'. A minha mulher = my wife. Mulher de negócios = businesswoman. Roupa de mulher = women's clothing. Plural: mulheres.
Masculine noun 'son'. Plural 'filhos' = sons OR children (both). Feminine: filha (daughter). Filho único = only child. Filhos (pl.) in mixed-gender context = children.

examples.pt: Tenho dois filhos, um rapaz e uma rapariga.
examples.en: I have two children, a boy and a girl.

notes: Masculine noun 'name'. Como é o teu nome? = What's your name? Primeiro nome = first name. Apelido = surname. Nome de utilizador = username. Em nome de = on behalf of.
Adjective/pronoun 'other/another'. Outro/outra/outros/outras. No article before it: quero outro = I want another (not 'um outro'). O outro = the other one.

examples.pt: Quero um outro café, por favor.

notes: Adjective/pronoun 'all/every/whole'. Todo/toda/todos/todas. Todo o dia = all day / the whole day. Todos os dias = every day. Todo o mundo = everyone. Contrast with tudo (pronoun).

examples.pt: Todos os dias caminho meia hora.
examples.en: Every day I walk for half an hour.

notes: Irregular verb 'to give'. Many idiomatic uses: dar uma volta = to go for a walk; dá para... = it's possible to...; não dá = it doesn't work/it's not possible.

examples.en: Can you give me your number?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to try/attempt'. Tentar + infinitive = to try to do. Pelo menos tentei = at least I tried. Tentar a sorte = to try one's luck.

examples.en: I'll try to do that tomorrow.

notes: Irregular verb 'to leave/go out/exit'. Sair de casa = to leave home. Sair à noite = to go out at night. Saiu bem = it turned out well. Note irregular present: saio.
Regular -ar verb 'to think'. Pensar em = to think about. Pensar que = to think that. O que pensas? = What do you think? Penso, logo existo = I think, therefore I am.
Masculine noun 'world'. Todo o mundo = everyone. O mundo inteiro = the whole world. Homem do mundo = man of the world. Vir ao mundo = to come into the world (be born).

examples.pt: O mundo está a mudar muito rápido.
examples.en: The world is changing very fast.

notes: Masculine noun 'friend'. Feminine: amiga. Plural: amigos/amigas. Melhor amigo = best friend. Ser amigo de = to be friends with. False friend: 'amigo' never means 'boyfriend'.

examples.pt: O João é o meu melhor amigo.

notes: Masculine noun 'problem'. Note: masculine despite ending in -a (Greek origin). Sem problema = no problem. Problema de saúde = health issue. Resolver um problema = to solve a problem.
Masculine noun 'car'. De carro = by car. Andar de carro = to drive/travel by car. Estacionamento de carro = car park. Note: 'automóvel' is formal, 'viatura' is official.

examples.pt: Vamos de carro ou a pé?
examples.en: Shall we go by car or on foot?

notes: Adjective 'new/young'. Novo/nova/novos/novas. Brand new: completamente novo. Novo em folha = brand new. As a noun: os novos = the young people. Antonym: velho.
Ordinal adjective 'first'. Primeiro/primeira. Em primeiro lugar = first of all. Pela primeira vez = for the first time. Primeiro andar = first floor (EU) / second floor (BR).

examples.pt: É a primeira vez que venho aqui.
examples.en: It's the first time I've come here.

notes: Masculine noun 'place/spot/seat/room'. Em primeiro lugar = firstly. Ter lugar = to take place. Guardar um lugar = to save a seat. Em lugar de = instead of.

examples.pt: Este é o meu lugar favorito.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to return/come back/go back'. Voltar a casa = to go home. Voltar a fazer = to do again. Voltar atrás = to go back/reverse a decision.

examples.en: When do you get back from holidays?

notes: Feminine noun 'family'. Família alargada = extended family. Em família = with family. Homem/mulher de família = family man/woman. Pl: famílias.

examples.pt: Passo o Natal com a família.
examples.en: I spend Christmas with my family.

notes: Adverb 'there/over there' (slightly more specific/closer than lá). Ali mesmo = right there. Por ali = that way/around there. Often interchangeable with 'lá' in colloquial speech.

examples.pt: Ele está ali à tua espera.
examples.en: He's right there waiting for you.

notes: Demonstrative adjective/pronoun 'that (over there, far from both)'. Aquele/aquela/aqueles/aquelas. Contracts with em: naquele. Three-way: este/esse/aquele.

examples.pt: Aquele homem ali é o meu pai.
examples.en: That man over there is my father.

notes: Feminine noun 'hour/time/moment'. Que horas são? = What time is it? A que horas? = At what time? Horas extra = overtime. Meia hora = half an hour. Na hora = on the spot.
Feminine noun 'police (force)'. Also masculine 'polícia' = police officer. Chamar a polícia = to call the police. Esquadra da polícia = police station.

examples.en: We have to call the police.

notes: Masculine noun 'love'. Fazer amor = to make love. Amor à primeira vista = love at first sight. Por amor de Deus = for the love of God. Meu amor = my love (term of address).
Feminine noun 'person'. Note: always feminine grammatically, even when referring to a man (uma pessoa boa = a good person). Plural: pessoas. Em pessoa = in person.

examples.pt: Ela é uma pessoa muito simpática.
examples.en: She is a very nice person.

notes: Feminine noun 'head'. Dor de cabeça = headache. Perder a cabeça = to lose one's head. Meter na cabeça = to get into one's head. Cabeça de lista = top of the list.
Regular -ar verb 'to help'. Ajudar + a + infinitive = to help to do. Posso ajudar? = Can I help? Obrigado pela ajuda = thanks for the help.

examples.en: Can you help me with this?

notes: Feminine noun 'afternoon'. Also adverb 'late'. Boa tarde = good afternoon. De tarde = in the afternoon. Chegar tarde = to arrive late. Mais tarde = later.
Adjective/adverb 'ready/done/alright'. Estás pronto? = Are you ready? Pronto! = Done! / Alright! Also used as a filler: pronto, é assim = well, that's how it is. Feminine: pronta.

examples.en: Are you ready to go out?

notes: Feminine noun 'city'. Centro da cidade = city centre. Cidade natal = hometown. Grande cidade = big city. Contrast with vila (town) and aldeia (village).

examples.pt: Lisboa é uma cidade muito bonita.
examples.en: Lisbon is a very beautiful city.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to find/meet/encounter'. Encontrar alguém = to meet/run into someone. Encontrar-se = to meet up. Onde posso encontrar? = Where can I find?
Regular -ar verb: 'to leave (something)/let/allow/stop'. Deixa-me = let me / leave me alone. Deixar de = to stop doing. Deixar cair = to drop. Deixa estar = leave it.
Feminine noun 'people/folks'. Colloquially, 'a gente' = we/us (takes 3rd person singular verb): a gente vai = we're going. Very common in spoken Brazilian PT.

examples.pt: A gente aqui é muito simpática.
examples.en: The people here are very friendly.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to enter/go in/come in'. Entrar em = to enter. Pode entrar = come in. Entrar em contacto = to get in touch. Antonym: sair.
Semi-irregular -ar verb 'to arrive/get (somewhere)/be enough'. C→QU before E. Chegar a = to reach/arrive at. Chegar atrasado = to arrive late. Isso chega = that's enough.

examples.pt: A que horas chegas a casa?
examples.en: What time do you get home?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to work'. Trabalhar em = to work in/at. Trabalhar muito = to work hard. Trabalhar por conta própria = to be self-employed.

examples.pt: Trabalho num escritório no centro da cidade.
examples.en: I work in an office in the city centre.

notes: Adverb 'almost/nearly/hardly'. Quase nunca = almost never. Quase sempre = almost always. Estou quase! = Almost done / I'm almost ready!
Feminine noun 'story/history/tale'. História de Portugal = History of Portugal. Contar uma história = to tell a story. Isso é outra história = that's another story. Pl: histórias.
Irregular -er verb 'to die'. O→U in present 1st person: morro. Morrer de fome = to be starving. Morrer de rir = to die laughing. Estou a morrer de frio = I'm freezing.
Feminine noun 'door'. Bater à porta = to knock on the door. Porta de entrada = front door. Fora de portas = outside the city. À porta = at the door.
Feminine noun 'death'. Pena de morte = death penalty. À beira da morte = near death. De morte = deadly. Note: 'morte' and 'morrer' share the same root.

examples.pt: A morte do rei foi um choque.
examples.en: The king's death was a shock.

notes: Highly irregular verb 'to come'. Present: venho, vens, vem... Note: vir a = to end up doing. Vem cá! = Come here! Vir abaixo = to collapse. Similar to but different from 'ir' (to go).

examples.en: Are you coming with us to the restaurant?

notes: Adjective 'happy'. Invariable for gender (feliz homem / feliz mulher). Plural: felizes. Feliz aniversário = happy birthday. Feliz Natal = Merry Christmas. Antonym: triste.

examples.pt: Estou muito feliz com os resultados.
examples.en: I'm very happy with the results.

notes: Adjective 'each/every'. Invariable. Cada um = each one. Cada vez mais = more and more. Cada vez menos = less and less. Cada dia = each day. Não pode ser cada vez assim = it can't always be like this.

examples.pt: Cada pessoa tem o seu próprio estilo.
examples.en: Each person has their own style.

notes: Masculine noun 'year'. Todos os anos = every year. Quantos anos tens? = How old are you? Fazer anos = to have a birthday. Ano Novo = New Year. Pl: anos.

examples.pt: Faço vinte e cinco anos amanhã.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to take/carry/bring (along)'. Levar tempo = to take time. Levar a sério = to take seriously. Quanto tempo leva? = How long does it take?

examples.pt: Quanto tempo leva a chegar lá?
examples.en: How long does it take to get there?

notes: Masculine noun 'room/bedroom'. Quarto de dormir = bedroom. Quarto de hotel = hotel room. Um quarto = a quarter (1/4). São três e um quarto = it's quarter past three.

examples.pt: O teu quarto é muito arrumado.

notes: Adjective 'difficult/hard'. Invariable for gender. Plural: difíceis. É difícil de explicar = it's hard to explain. Contrasts with fácil. Dificuldade = difficulty (noun).
Feminine noun 'morning'. Bom dia/Bom manhã = Good morning. De manhã = in the morning. Esta manhã = this morning. Amanhã de manhã = tomorrow morning. Note accent.

examples.pt: Gosto de correr de manhã cedo.
examples.en: I like to run early in the morning.

notes: Adjective 'important'. Invariable for gender. Plural: importantes. É importante que + subjunctive = it's important that. Mais importante = more important.

examples.pt: É importante estudar todos os dias.
examples.en: It's important to study every day.

notes: Irregular verb 'to be able to/can'. Present 1st person: posso. Used for ability, permission, possibility. Não posso = I can't. Pode ser = maybe/could be.

Feminine noun 'water'. Note: begins with stressed 'a', so takes masculine article (o) before a singular: o água would be wrong — but 'a água' in European PT or 'água' alone. Água mineral = mineral water.

examples.pt: Podes trazer um copo de água?
examples.en: Can you bring a glass of water?

notes: Semi-irregular -ar verb 'to begin/start'. C→Ç before A/O. Começar a + inf = to start doing. Por onde começamos? = Where do we start?

examples.pt: A reunião começa às dez horas.
examples.en: The meeting starts at ten o'clock.

notes: Feminine noun 'week'. Esta semana = this week. A semana passada = last week. A semana que vem = next week. Fim de semana = weekend. Dia da semana = weekday.

examples.pt: No fim de semana vou ao campo.
examples.en: At the weekend I'm going to the countryside.

notes: Masculine noun 'body'. Corpo humano = human body. Linguagem corporal = body language. Corpo de bombeiros = fire brigade. Guardar o corpo = to keep fit.

examples.pt: O exercício faz bem ao corpo.
examples.en: Exercise is good for the body.

notes: Feminine noun 'war'. Em guerra = at war. Declarar guerra = to declare war. Guerra fria = cold war. Guerra civil = civil war. Pós-guerra = post-war.

examples.en: The war brought a great deal of suffering.

notes: Regular -er verb 'to eat'. Comer fora = to eat out. Comer bem = to eat well. O que comemos? = What are we eating? Dar de comer = to feed.

examples.pt: O que queres comer ao jantar?
examples.en: What do you want to eat for dinner?

notes: Irregular -ir verb 'to sleep'. O→U in 1st person singular: durmo. Dormir bem = to sleep well. Estar a dormir = to be sleeping. Dormir fora = to sleep away from home.

examples.en: I slept very badly last night.

notes: Feminine noun 'school'. Ir à escola = to go to school. Escola primária = primary school. Escola secundária = secondary school. Escola superior / universidade = university.

examples.pt: Os filhos foram para a escola.

notes: Masculine noun 'heart'. Doença do coração = heart disease. De coração = heartfelt/sincerely. Coração partido = broken heart. Meu coração = my heart (term of endearment).

examples.en: He speaks from the bottom of his heart.

notes: Regular -er verb 'to live (life/in a place)'. Viver em = to live in. Viver bem = to live well. Viver do quê? = to live on what? Contrast with morar (to reside at an address).

examples.pt: Vivo em Lisboa há cinco anos.
examples.en: I've been living in Lisbon for five years.

notes: Feminine noun 'hand'. Note the nasal diphthong ão. Dar a mão = to hold hands. Mão de obra = workforce/labour. À mão = by hand. Pl: mãos.
Adjective 'bad/evil/wicked'. Feminine: má. Plural: maus/más. De mau humor = in a bad mood. Mau tempo = bad weather. In Brazilian PT, 'ruim' is more common for 'bad'.
Adjective 'fast/quick'. Also adverb 'quickly/fast'. Rapidamente = quickly (adverb). Quanto mais rápido, melhor = the faster the better. Antonym: lento.
Regular -er verb 'to lose/miss'. Perder o comboio = to miss the train. Perder-se = to get lost. Perder o emprego = to lose one's job. Não percas! = Don't miss it!
Regular -ar verb: 'to wait/hope/expect'. Esperar por = to wait for. Esperar que + subjunctive = to hope that. Espero que sim = I hope so. Sala de espera = waiting room.
Regular -ar verb 'to finish/end'. Acabar de + inf = to have just done: acabei de comer = I just ate. Acabar com = to end (a relationship). Quando acaba? = When does it end?
Adjective 'easy'. Invariable for gender. Plural: fáceis. Mais fácil = easier. Facilmente = easily. É mais fácil do que parece = it's easier than it looks. Antonym: difícil.
Adjective 'old (thing or person)'. Velho/velha/velhos/velhas. As a noun: os velhos = old people. Velho amigo = old friend (long-time). Antonym: novo. Note: 'idoso' is more polite for elderly people.

examples.pt: Este é um velho costume português.
examples.en: This is an old Portuguese custom.

notes: Adjective 'small/little/young'. Pequeno/pequena. Quando era pequeno = when I was little/young. Pequeno almoço (PT-EU) = breakfast. Pequenas coisas = small things.

examples.pt: Tenho um apartamento pequeno mas acolhedor.
examples.en: I have a small but cosy apartment.

notes: Adjective 'wrong/incorrect/mistaken'. Errado/errada. Número errado = wrong number. Estar errado = to be wrong/mistaken. Dar errado = to go wrong.
Feminine noun 'peace'. Em paz = at peace/in peace. Deixa-me em paz = leave me alone. Fazer as pazes = to make up/reconcile. Paz e sossego = peace and quiet. Pl: pazes.

examples.en: We need peace in the world.

notes: Feminine noun 'bed'. Ir para a cama = to go to bed. Estar na cama = to be in bed (sick). Fazer a cama = to make the bed. Roupa de cama = bed linen. Pl: camas.

examples.pt: Já está na hora de ir para a cama.
examples.en: It's time to go to bed.

notes: Feminine noun 'food/meal'. A comida está pronta = the food is ready. Comida rápida = fast food. Comida caseira = home cooking. Fazer comida = to cook. Pl: comidas.
Adverb/adjective 'quite/enough/rather/fairly'. As adverb invariable; as adjective agrees: bastante trabalho / bastantes pessoas. Já chega, isso é bastante = that's enough.
Feminine noun 'word'. Cumprir a palavra = to keep one's word. Dar a sua palavra = to give one's word. Jogo de palavras = wordplay/pun. Pl: palavras.

examples.pt: Não percebo o significado dessa palavra.
examples.en: I don't understand the meaning of that word.

notes: Adjective 'different'. Invariable for gender. Plural: diferentes. Muito diferente = very different. Ser diferente de = to be different from. Antonym: igual/semelhante.

examples.pt: As duas culturas são muito diferentes.
examples.en: The two cultures are very different.

notes: Semi-irregular -ar verb 'to pay'. G→GU before E in subjunctive. Pagar em dinheiro = to pay cash. Pagar com cartão = to pay by card. Posso pagar? = Can I pay?

examples.pt: Posso pagar com cartão de crédito?
examples.en: Can I pay by credit card?

notes: Masculine noun 'doctor/physician'. Feminine: médica. Ir ao médico = to go to the doctor. Médico de família = family doctor/GP. Médico especialista = specialist.

examples.pt: Preciso de marcar consulta com o médico.
examples.en: I need to make an appointment with the doctor.

notes: Masculine noun 'country/nation'. Note accent (país). De que país és? = What country are you from? Chefe de estado = head of state. País natal = homeland. Pl: países.

examples.pt: Portugal é um país muito bonito.
examples.en: Portugal is a very beautiful country.

notes: Adjective 'special'. Invariable for gender. Plural: especiais. Edição especial = special edition. Ocasião especial = special occasion. Em especial = especially/in particular.

examples.pt: Este dia é muito especial para mim.
examples.en: This day is very special to me.

notes: Irregular verb 'to want/love'. Quero = I want. Não queres? = Don't you want? Querer dizer = to mean. Querer bem = to care for/love (non-romantic). Que queres? = What do you want?

examples.en: I want to learn more languages.

notes: Regular -er verb 'to drink'. Beber água = to drink water. O que queres beber? = What do you want to drink? Beber de mais = to drink too much.

examples.en: Do you want something to drink?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to win/earn/gain'. Ganhar dinheiro = to earn money. Ganhar a vida = to earn a living. Ganhar um jogo = to win a game. Quem ganhou? = Who won?

examples.pt: Ganhámos o jogo por três a zero.
examples.en: We won the game three to nil.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to need'. Preciso de + noun/inf = I need. Precisar de ajuda = to need help. Do que precisas? = What do you need?

examples.pt: Preciso de ajuda com este problema.
examples.en: I need help with this problem.

notes: Feminine noun 'street'. Na rua = in the street. Rua principal = main street. Ficar na rua = to end up homeless. Morador da rua = street resident. Pl: ruas.

examples.en: I live on a very quiet street.

notes: Masculine noun 'foot'. A pé = on foot. De pé = standing. Pé de página = footnote. Em pé de igualdade = on equal footing. Pl: pés. Note accent (pé).

examples.en: I prefer to go on foot.

notes: Adjective 'last/final/latest'. Último/última. A última vez = the last time. O último do mês = the last day of the month. Até ao último = to the last. Antonym: primeiro.

examples.pt: É a última vez que te digo isto.
examples.en: This is the last time I'll tell you this.

notes: Feminine noun 'mouth'. Abrir a boca = to open one's mouth. Calar a boca = to shut up. Boca do estômago = pit of the stomach. De boca em boca = by word of mouth. Pl: bocas.
Regular -ar verb 'to buy'. Comprar em segunda mão = to buy second-hand. Ir às compras = to go shopping. Onde posso comprar? = Where can I buy?
Regular -ar verb 'to ask (a question)'. Perguntar a alguém = to ask someone. Posso perguntar? = May I ask? Contrast with pedir (to ask for/request).
Adjective 'free/available'. Invariable for gender. Plural: livres. Está livre? = Is this seat free? Tempo livre = free time. Livre de = free from. Liberdade = freedom (noun).

examples.en: Do you have free time tomorrow?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to look for/seek/search'. Procurar trabalho = to look for work. O que procuras? = What are you looking for? Procurar no Google = to Google.

examples.pt: Estou a procurar o meu telemóvel.
examples.en: I'm looking for my mobile phone.

notes: Adjective 'beautiful/pretty/nice/handsome'. Bonito/bonita. Que bonito! = How beautiful! More versatile than belo (more literary). Also used for nice actions/moments.
Adjective 'true/real/genuine'. Verdadeiro/verdadeira. A verdadeira razão = the real reason. Um amigo verdadeiro = a true friend. Contrast with falso (false) and verdade (truth noun).
Semi-irregular verb 'to know (a person/place)/meet'. C→Ç before O/A. Conheces Lisboa? = Do you know Lisbon? Prazer em conhecer-te! = Nice to meet you! Contrast with saber (to know facts).
Regular -ir verb 'to open'. Irregular past participle: aberto. Abrir a porta = to open the door. Abrir a boca = to open one's mouth. Loja aberta = shop open.

examples.pt: Pode abrir a janela, por favor?
examples.en: Can you open the window, please?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to like/enjoy'. Always followed by 'de': gostar de música = to like music. Gosto muito de ti = I really like you. Não gosto nada = I don't like it at all.
Masculine noun 'government'. Chefe do governo = head of government. Governo central = central government. Membro do governo = cabinet member. Pl: governos.
Feminine noun 'voice'. Em voz alta = aloud/in a loud voice. Em voz baixa = in a low voice. Dar voz a = to give a voice to. Voz ativa/passiva = active/passive voice. Pl: vozes.

examples.en: She has a very beautiful voice.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to show/display'. Mostrar a alguém = to show someone. Pode mostrar-me? = Can you show me? Mostrar os resultados = to show the results.

examples.en: Can you show me the way?

notes: Irregular verb 'to bring'. Note irregular present: trago. Future/conditional contract: trarei/traria. Trazer consigo = to bring along. O que trouxeste? = What did you bring?

examples.pt: Podes trazer a conta, por favor?
examples.en: Can you bring the bill, please?

notes: Masculine noun 'eye'. Plural: olhos. De olhos fechados = with eyes closed. A olho nu = with the naked eye. Olhar nos olhos = to look in the eyes. Cuida-te! (lit: take care of your eyes).
Feminine noun 'law/act/rule'. Cumprir a lei = to obey the law. Contra a lei = against the law. Lei fundamental = basic law/constitution. Aprovação de uma lei = passing of a law. Pl: leis.
Masculine noun 'month'. Note accent (mês). Por mês = per month. O mês passado = last month. O mês que vem = next month. Pl: meses (no accent in plural).

examples.pt: Ela viaja a Portugal todos os meses.
examples.en: She travels to Portugal every month.

notes: Adjective 'full/filled'. Cheio/cheia/cheios/cheias. Estou cheio = I'm full (after eating). Cheio de = full of. Estar cheio de trabalho = to be swamped with work.
Regular -ar verb 'to explain'. Explicar a alguém = to explain to someone. Podes explicar? = Can you explain? Explicação = explanation.

examples.en: Can you explain to me how it works?

notes: Regular -er verb 'to learn'. Aprender línguas = to learn languages. Estou a aprender = I'm learning. Aprender de cor = to learn by heart. Aprendizagem = learning (noun).

examples.pt: Estou a aprender português há seis meses.
examples.en: I've been learning Portuguese for six months.

notes: Adjective 'hot/warm'. Invariable for gender. Plural: quentes. Está muito quente = it's very hot. Água quente = hot water. Chocolate quente = hot chocolate. Antonym: frio.
Adjective 'cold' (frio/fria) or noun 'cold/coldness' (o frio). Está frio = it's cold. Tenho frio = I'm cold. Água fria = cold water. Que frio! = How cold! Antonym: quente.

examples.en: How cold! Will you close the window?

notes: Adjective 'sad/unhappy'. Invariable for gender. Plural: tristes. Estou triste = I'm sad. Uma história triste = a sad story. Tristeza = sadness (noun). Antonym: feliz.

examples.en: Why are you so sad today?

notes: Adjective 'white'. Branco/branca. Vinho branco = white wine. Deixar em branco = to leave blank. Em branco = blank. Ficar em branco = to go blank (mentally).
Adjective 'poor'. Invariable for gender. Plural: pobres. As a noun: os pobres = the poor. Pobre coitado = poor thing. Antonym: rico. Pobreza = poverty (noun).
Feminine noun 'window'. Abrir/fechar a janela = to open/close the window. Lugar da janela = window seat. Montra (PT-EU) / vitrine (PT-BR) = shop window. Pl: janelas.
Feminine noun 'kitchen/cuisine'. Na cozinha = in the kitchen. Cozinha portuguesa = Portuguese cuisine. Fazer de cozinha = to cook. Empregado de cozinha = kitchen worker. Pl: cozinhas.
Adjective 'necessary'. Necessário/necessária. É necessário que + subjunctive = it's necessary that. Se necessário = if necessary. Necessidade = necessity (noun).
Masculine noun 'arm'. De braços abertos = with open arms (warm welcome). Braço direito = right-hand man. Cruzar os braços = to fold one's arms. Pl: braços.

examples.pt: Ela usa uma pulseira no braço.
examples.en: She wears a bracelet on her arm.

notes: Adjective 'blue'. Invariable for gender. Plural: azuis. Azul celeste = sky blue. Azul marinho = navy blue. Sangue azul = blue blood (noble). Mar azul = blue sea.
Adjective 'red'. Vermelho/vermelha. Vinho tinto (not vermelho) = red wine. Cruz Vermelha = Red Cross. Ficar vermelho = to blush. Semáforo vermelho = red traffic light.
Regular -er verb 'to respond/answer'. Responder a = to answer (a question/email). Resposta = answer/reply (noun). Não respondeste = you didn't answer.
Regular -ar verb 'to think/find/believe'. Acho que = I think that. O que achas? = What do you think? Não acho = I don't think so. Also: achar = to find (an object, informal).

examples.en: What do you think of this idea?

notes: Feminine noun 'leg'. De perna cruzada = cross-legged. Esticar as pernas = to stretch one's legs. Perna de frango = chicken leg. Partir a perna = to break one's leg. Pl: pernas.

examples.pt: Parti a perna a jogar futebol.
examples.en: I broke my leg playing football.

notes: Adjective 'black'. Preto/preta. Café preto = black coffee. Em preto e branco = in black and white. Note: 'negro' exists but is more sensitive; 'preto' is the standard adjective for the color.

examples.en: I prefer black coffee without sugar.

notes: Adjective 'green'. Invariable for gender. Plural: verdes. Vinho verde = young/light wine (famous PT wine). Semáforo verde = green light. Salada verde = green salad.

examples.pt: As árvores estão muito verdes na primavera.
examples.en: The trees are very green in spring.
